(أنزلناه) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn… and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلى) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلناه). (اللام) the lām of causation. (تخرج) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you". (الناس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من الظلمات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرج). (إلى النور) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرج). (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of تخرج, i.e. "accompanied by the permission of their Lord". (ربّهم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr)… and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى صراط) badal (substitute) for (إلى النور), with repetition of the preposition. (العزيز) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الحميد) badal for العزيز, genitive — or a naʿt (adjective) of it —.
The clause «(هذا) كتاب ...» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «أنزلناه ...» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of كتاب.
The clause «تخرج ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تخرج..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزلناه).

* Rhetoric:
1- Metaphor (al-istiʿāra): in the words of the Exalted لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ.
The speech contains three metaphors: one of them in the permission, and the last two in (الظلمات) and (النور). It is also possible that all of it is a compound representational metaphor (istiʿāra murakkaba tamthīliyya), depicting guidance as light and misguidance as darkness. His words «بإذن ربهم» mean by His facilitation and granting of success, exalted be He; it is borrowed from the permission that entails easing [the way past] the veil.

safi-cedvel:2-3.t:
* I'rab:
(الله) the Name of Majesty, badal (substitute) for الحميد — or for العزيز — [Note: In the previous verse (1)… It may be an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition)…], (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (الواو) a conjunction. (ما في الأرض) like ما في السموات and conjoined to it. (الواو) a conjunction. ويل mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: What permitted beginning with an indefinite noun is its denoting a supplication.], (للكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ويل. (من عذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of (ويل) [Note: Or attached to an omitted verb whose implied form is يضجّون ("they cry out") or يولون ("they wail"); attaching it to ويل is not allowed because of the separator, namely the khabar (للكافرين).], (شديد) a naʿt of عذاب, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «له ما في السموات ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative الذي.
The clause «ويل للكافرين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause (هذا) كتاب in the previous verse.
(الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ [Note: Or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هم… or in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being أذمّ ("I censure")… or in the position of genitive as a badal for الكافرين. Abū Ḥayyān rejected the view of al-Zamakhsharī and Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī that it is an adjective of الكافرين, because of the separator.], (يستحبّون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn… and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent). (الحياة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الدّنيا) a naʿt of الحياة, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif. (على الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يستحبّون), by its being made to carry the meaning of يفضّلون ("they prefer"). (الواو) a conjunction. (يصدّون) like يستحبّون. (عن سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يصدّون). (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) a conjunction. (يبغونها) like يستحبّون, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (عوجا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "crooked" [Note: Or it is the mafʿūl bihi of the verb يبغون, if the third-person pronoun in (يبغونها) is taken as accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "they seek crookedness for it"… See verse (99) of Sūrat Āl ʿImrān.], (أولئك) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ… and (الكاف) a particle of address. (في ضلال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك. (بعيد) a naʿt of ضلال, genitive like it.
The clause «الذين يستحبّون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يستحبّون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «يصدّون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يبغونها ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك في ضلال ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الّذين).

* Rhetoric:
1- Rational (cognitive) trope (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī): in the words of the Exalted فِي ضَلالٍ بَعِيدٍ, describing misguidance as far is a figurative attribution; in reality the farness belongs to the one who strays, since he is the one who goes far from the road, so his act was described by it, just as you say جدّ جدّه ("his earnestness was earnest") and داهية دهياء ("a calamitous calamity").
2- Making misguidance a container is also figurative, as though it had surrounded them and wrapped them in its blackness, so that they are immersed in it up to the chins, stumbling about in its mazes and wandering aimlessly in its darknesses.

* Benefits:
- الويل is a word conveying threat and menace, and its meaning is destruction. One says ويلا لفلان, putting it in the accusative, and one also says ويل له, just as one says سلام عليه.

safi-cedvel:4-4.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative. (أرسلنا) like أنزلنا [Note: In verse (1) of this sura.], (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (رسول) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (بلسان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of رسول [Note: The one the ḥāl describes may be indefinite, namely (رسول), because the word denotes generality.], i.e. "speaking" or "accompanied by". (قومه) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr)… and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) for causation. (يبيّن) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he". (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبيّن).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يبيّن..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أرسلنا) [Note: This verb has its object restricted by his tongue being of the tongue of his people.].
(الفاء) resumptive. (يضلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يشاء) like يضلّ. (الواو) a conjunction. (يهدي) like يضلّ, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is "He". (من يشاء) like the first. (الواو) resumptive. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (العزيز) khabar (predicate), nominative. (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «ما أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يبيّن ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يضلّ الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative (من).
The clause «يهدي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يضلّ.
The clause «يشاء (the second) ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «هو العزيز ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
- Trope (al-majāz): in the words of the Exalted إِلَّا بِلِسانِ قَوْمِهِ, i.e. speaking the language of the nations to whom he was sent; the relation is causality, because the tongue is the instrument of speech.

* Benefits:
- It is a condition for a multiple khabar that each of the two or three predicates have an independent meaning, as in this verse. If the two predicates form a single quality, it is not a case of multiple khabar: if we say «الرمّان حلو حامض» ("the pomegranates are sweet sour"), this is not a case of multiple khabar, because the pomegranate in this case «is مزّ», i.e. «لفّان» (sweet-and-sour). So look carefully before you judge.

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation. (أرسلنا) like أنزلنا [Note: In verse (1) of this sura.], (موسى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif. (بآياتنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of موسى… and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أن) explicative (tafsīriyya) [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, the interpreted maṣdar being genitive by an implied bāʾ of transitivity.], (أخرج) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you". (قومك) mafʿūl bihi, accusative… and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi. (من الظلمات إلى النور) a preposition and its genitive noun, repeated, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أخرج). (الواو) a conjunction. (ذكّرهم) like أخرج…
and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بأيّام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذكّر). (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative. (في) a preposition. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate)… and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address. (اللام) for emphasis. (آيات) the noun of إنّ, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آيات. (صبّار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (شكور) a naʿt of صبّار, genitive.
The clause «أرسلنا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of an implied oath.
The clause «أخرج ...» has no grammatical position: explicative [Note: Or it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).].
The clause «ذكّرهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أخرج.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(صبّار): one of the intensive forms (ṣiyagh al-mubālagha), on the pattern فعّال with fatḥa on the fāʾ and a doubled ʿayn, from the triliteral verb صبر.
(شكور): one of the intensive forms, on the pattern فعول with fatḥa on the fāʾ, from the triliteral verb شكر.

safi-cedvel:6-8.t:
[Note: See verse (49) of Sūrat al-Baqara, for it is the counterpart of the verse above.]
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إذ) an adverbial noun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر ("remember") [Note: Abū Ḥayyān rejects taking (إذ) out of pure adverbiality, and attaches the adverb to an omitted word required by the context of the speech.], (قال) a past verb. (موسى) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif. (لقومه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال)…
and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; the pronoun here is a muḍāf ilayhi]. (اذكروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn…
and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to نعمة [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of نعمة.], (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (نعمة) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) for نعمة.], (أنجاكم) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif… and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "He". (من آل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنجى). (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa [Translator's note: it is a diptote]. (يسومونكم) an imperfect verb, nominative… and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (كم) like the last. (سوء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (العذاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) a conjunction. (يذبّحون) like يسومون. (أبناءكم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative… and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (يستحيون نساءكم) like يذبّحون أبناءكم. (الواو) a conjunction. (في) a preposition. (ذلكم) like ذلك [Note: In the previous verse (5).] — in i'rab and attachment —. (بلاء) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (من ربّكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of بلاء… and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (عظيم) a second naʿt of بلاء, nominative.
The clause «(اذكر) إذ قال موسى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قال موسى ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اذكروا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أنجاكم ...» is in the position of genitive by (إذ) being annexed to it.
The clause «يسومونكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of (آل فرعون), or of the pronoun of address in (أنجاكم).
The clause «يذبّحون ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يسومونكم.
The clause «يستحيون ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يسومونكم.
The clause «في ذلك بلاء ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
(الواو) a conjunction. (إذ تأذّن) like إذ أنجى and conjoined to it [Note: So it is part of the speech of Moses, upon him be peace, and in terms of meaning it is the object of اذكروا.], (ربّكم) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) paving the way for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam). (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (شكرتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)… and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil. (اللام) the lām of the oath. (أزيدنّكم) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative… and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "I". (الواو) a conjunction. (لئن كفرتم) like لئن شكرتم. (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative. (عذابي) the noun of إنّ, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) for emphasis — the lām of the oath or the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) —. (شديد) the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «تأذّن ربّكم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إن شكرتم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb, its implied form being يقول ("saying") [Note: If (تأذن) is treated like قال, the clause is explicative.].
The clause «أزيدنّكم ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of the oath… and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer of the oath.
The clause «كفرتم ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause شكرتم.
The clause «إنّ عذابي لشديد ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of the second oath ...
and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the answer of the oath.
(الواو) a conjunction. (قال موسى) like the first. (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (تكفروا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil of تكفروا. (الواو) a conjunction. (من) a relative noun, conjoined to the wāw in (تكفروا), in the position of nominative. (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من. (جميعا) a ḥāl, accusative, from the relative من. (الفاء) linking the apodosis. (إنّ الله لغنيّ) like إنّ عذابي لشديد. (حميد) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قال موسى ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the first clause قال موسى.
The clause «تكفروا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl… and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then you have harmed yourselves"… or "then the harm of your disbelief falls only on you".
The clause «إنّ الله لغنيّ ...» has no grammatical position: a causal explanation of the omitted apodosis.

* Benefits:
- The birth of Moses:
History has preserved for us that one of Pharaoh's soothsayers came to him [saying] that a child would be born among the Children of Israel at whose hand his kingdom would go. His fury flared up, he persisted blindly in his falsehood and went deep into his error, and he ordered that their sons be slaughtered and their women be kept alive. But the power of Allah the Exalted is too lofty for any oppressor's scheming to stand before it, so He decreed in His pre-eternity that from the midst of these oppressed ones would come forth one at whose hands the kingdom of the tyrants would be shaken, and through whom the greatest of the Pharaohs would be brought to an end.

safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation. (لم) a particle of negation and jussive. (يأتكم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter… and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (نبأ) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (من قبلكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative… and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (قوم) badal (substitute) for the relative, genitive (majrūr). (نوح) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) a conjunction in the following places. (عاد، ثمود، الذين) nouns conjoined to قوم by the conjunctions [Note: The last (الذّين) may be parsed as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the clause لا يعلمهم إلّا الله, the nominal clause being conjoined to the resumptive one.], (من بعدهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative… and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (لا) negative. (يعلمهم) an imperfect verb, nominative… and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (جاءت) a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine, and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (رسلهم) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (بالبيّنات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of رسلهم. (الفاء) a conjunction. (ردّوا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (أيديهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (في أفواههم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ردّوا), by its being made to carry the meaning of وضعوا ("they placed"), and (هم) like the last. (الواو) a conjunction. (قالوا) like ردّوا. (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb… and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (كفرنا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (كفرنا). (أرسلتم) a past verb, passive, indeclinable on the sukūn… and (تم) a pronoun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the verb أرسلتم. (إنّا) like the first. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). (في شكّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of إنّ. (ممّا) like بما, attached to شكّ [Note: Or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شك.], (إليه) like به, attached to (تدعوننا), which is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn… and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (مريب) a naʿt of شكّ, genitive like it.
The clause «لم يأتكم نبأ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يعلمهم إلّا الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun concealed in the ṣila to which من بعدهم is attached.].
The clause «جاءتهم رسلهم ...» has no grammatical position: an explication of the news [Note: Or resumptive.].
The clause «ردّوا أيديهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause جاءتهم رسلهم.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ردّوا ...
The clause «إنّا كفرنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «كفرنا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «أرسلتم به ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the first relative (ما).
The clause «إنّا لفي شك ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «تدعوننا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).

* Rhetoric:
- Metonymy (al-kināya): in the words of the Exalted فَرَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْواهِهِمْ, what is meant is that they bit their hands in rage, from the intensity of their aversion to seeing the messengers and hearing their speech; the hand and the mouth are meant literally, and the "returning" is a metonymy for biting. The speech may be literal, and it may be a representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya), in that by the people's returning their hands to the mouths of the messengers, upon them be peace, is meant their refusal to accept their speech and listen to it, likened to placing the hand on the speaker's mouth to silence him.

* Benefits:
- فَرَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْواهِهِمْ:
The exegetes differed in establishing the meaning of this clause in several ways. Abū ʿUbayda said: the Arabs say of a man when he refrains from answering and falls silent: "He has returned his hand into his mouth", as a metonymy for rage and vexation; so it is a kind of proverb, i.e. they did not believe and did not respond to his call.

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(قالت) a past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (رسلهم) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ)… and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (الهمزة) for the interrogative of disavowal (istifhām inkārī). (في الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). (شكّ) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (فاطر) a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty — or a badal (substitute) — genitive (majrūr). (السموات) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات by the wāw, genitive. (يدعوكم) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "He". (اللام) for causation. (يغفر) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the fāʿil is "He". (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يغفر). (من ذنوبكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of the omitted object [Note: (من) is partitive, i.e. "He forgives you something of your sins"; or it is attached to the verb by its being made to carry the meaning of يخلّص ("rescue").], and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يغفر..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يدعوكم).
(الواو) a conjunction. (يؤخّركم) like يغفر and conjoined to it, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (إلى أجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤخّر). (مسمّى) a naʿt of أجل, genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied kasra on the alif. (قالوا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (إن) a particle of negation. (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (بشر) khabar, nominative. (مثلنا) a naʿt of بشر, nominative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (تريدون) an imperfect verb, nominative… and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (تصدّونا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (عن) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (تصدّونا). (كان) an incomplete past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it", and it is the returning pronoun. (يعبد) like يدعو. (آباؤنا) fāʿil, nominative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) linking the answer of an implied condition. (ائتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn… and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (بسلطان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائتوا). (مبين) a naʿt of سلطان, genitive like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تصدّونا..) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by تريدون.
The clause «قالت رسلهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أفي الله شكّ ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «يدعوكم ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The clause «يغفر ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يؤخّركم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يغفر.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إن أنتم إلّا بشر ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «تريدون ...» is in the position of nominative as a second naʿt of بشر [Note: It may be resumptive, and so have no grammatical position.].
The clause «تصدّونا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كان يعبد ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يعبد آباؤنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان.
The clause «ائتوا ...» is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the answer of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are messengers, then bring an authority".

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(قالت.. رسلهم) its i'rab has been given [Note: In the previous verse (10).], (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قالت). (إن نحن إلّا بشر مثلكم) like إن أنتم إلّا بشر مثلنا [Note: In the previous verse (10).], (الواو) a conjunction. (لكنّ) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) and accusative — an abrogator (nāsikh) —. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of لكنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (يمنّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is "He". (على) a preposition. (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (يمنّ). (يشاء) like يمنّ. (من عباده) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of يشاء, i.e. "He wills to charge him with the message, being one of His servants", and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (ما) negative. (كان) an incomplete past verb. (اللام) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (نأتيكم) an imperfect verb, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "we". (بسلطان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of نأتيكم. (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr). (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl of the fāʿil [Note: (بإذن الله) may be the khabar of كان, and (لنا) attached to a ḥāl of إذن الله.] (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن نأتيكم..) is in the position of nominative as the noun of كان.
(الواو) a conjunction. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتوكّل). (الفاء) linking the answer of an implied condition. (اللام) the lām of command. (يتوكّل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. (المؤمنون) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قالت.. رسلهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إن نحن إلّا بشر ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «لكنّ الله يمنّ ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «يمنّ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لكنّ.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «ما كان ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «نأتيكم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يتوكّل المؤمنون ...» is in the position of jussive as the answer of an implied condition, i.e.: "if the believers resolve on a matter, let them rely on Allah"… and the implied conditional clause is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl.

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction. (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (لنا) like the previous [Note: In the previous verse (11).], attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of ما. (ألّا نتوكّل) like أن نأتيكم [Note: In the previous verse (11).], and (لا) a particle of negation. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نتوكّل). (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstance). (قد) a particle of realisation. (هدانا) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif… and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "He". (سبلنا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb)… and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ألّا نتوكّل..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being في… and the preposition is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied meaning is: "What is with us, striving in abandoning reliance?"…
or "What excuse do we have, persisting in abandoning reliance?"
(الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (نصبرنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ)… and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is "we". (على) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or a relative in the position of genitive, the clause being its ṣila (relative clause), with the returning pronoun omitted, i.e. "you harmed us with it".], (آذيتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn… and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), a vowel-lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the mīm, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) a conjunction. (على الله ... المتوكّلون) the i'rab of its like has been given [Note: In the previous verse (11).].
The clause «ما لنا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) clause.
The clause «نتوكّل ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «قد هدانا ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «نصبرنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of an implied oath.
The clause «آذيتمونا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يتوكّل المتوكّلون ...» is the answer of an implied condition.

safi-cedvel:13-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قال) a past verb. (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). (كفروا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (لرسلهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (نخرجنّ) like نصبرنّ [Note: In the previous verse (12).], and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (من أرضنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نخرجنّ), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (أو) a conjunction. (لتعودنّ) the lām of the oath and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of like letters; and the (الواو), dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and (النون) is for emphasis. (في ملّتنا) like من أرضنا, attached to (تعودنّ). (الفاء) a conjunction. (أوحى) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. (إلى) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أوحى). (ربّهم) fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (لنهلكنّ) like لنخرجنّ. (الظّالمين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال الّذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «نخرجنّكم ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of an implied oath… and the implied oath clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech), in the position of accusative.
The clause «تعودنّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause answering the oath.
The clause «أوحى.. ربّهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «نهلكنّ ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of an implied oath… and the implied oath clause with its answer is an explication of the revelation (al-īḥāʾ).
(الواو) a conjunction. (لنسكننّكم) like لنخرجنّكم. (الأرض) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من بعدهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نسكن), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the reference is to the victory and the inheriting of the land… and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (اللام) a preposition. (من) a relative in the position of genitive, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (خاف) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he", and it is the returning pronoun. (مقامي) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ… and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (خاف وعيد) like خاف مقامي… and the pronoun of the speaker was dropped for lightness, to accord with the verse-ending (fāṣila).
The clause «نسكننّكم ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of the implied oath, and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the previous implied oath clause.
The clause «ذلك لمن خاف ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «خاف ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «خاف (the second) ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (من).
(الواو) a conjunction. (استفتحوا) a past verb with its fāʿil, and the pronoun refers to the prophets. (الواو) a conjunction. (خاب) a past verb. (كلّ) fāʿil, nominative. (جبّار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (عنيد) a naʿt (adjective) of جبّار, genitive.
The clause «استفتحوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أوحى.
The clause «خاب كلّ جبّار ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to something implied, i.e. "so they were given victory, and every stubborn tyrant failed ..."
(من ورائه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar… and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (جهنّم) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو) a conjunction. (يسقى) an imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma on the alif, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he", i.e. the tyrant. (من ماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يسقى). (صديد) badal (substitute) for ماء, genitive.
The clause «من ورائه جهنّم ...» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of (كلّ جبّار), or in the position of genitive as a naʿt of جبّار [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of كلّ جبّار.].
The clause «يسقى ...» is conjoined to the clause من ورائه جهنّم, taking its i'rab.
(يتجرّعه) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he". (الواو) a conjunction. (لا) negative. (يكاد) an incomplete imperfect verb, nominative, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he". (يسيغه) like يتجرّعه. (الواو) a conjunction. (يأتيه) like يتجرّعه, the ḍamma being implied. (الموت) fāʿil, nominative. (من كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأتيه). (مكان) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) circumstantial. (ما) negative, operating like ليس. (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the noun of ما. (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (ميّت) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما. (الواو) a conjunction. (من ورائه عذاب) like من ورائه جهنّم. (غليظ) a naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The clause «يتجرّعه ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of ماء [Note: Or a ḥāl of the pronoun of (يسقى)… or resumptive, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «لا يكاد يسيغه ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يتجرّعه [Note: Especially on the ḥāl interpretation; it may also be a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يتجرّعه or of its object.].
The clause «يسيغه ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of يكاد.
The clause «يأتيه الموت ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause لا يكاد ...
The clause «ما هو بميّت ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «من ورائه عذاب ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يأتيه الموت..

* Morphology:
(مقامي): a noun of place from the triliteral قام — according to al-Farrāʾ it is a mīmī maṣdar —. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: the wāw was changed into an alif because it is quiescent and the letter before it carries a fatḥa. Its pattern is مفعل and its original form is مقوم — with sukūn on the qāf and fatḥa on the wāw —.
(وعيد): the aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of وعد يعد when one threatens him with evil; its pattern is فعيل.
(صديد): a noun for the pus and blood that flows from a wound or a boil; its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
1- Hyperbole (al-mubālagha): in the words of the Exalted وَلا يَكادُ, the verb يكاد is brought in for hyperbole, meaning: he does not even come near to swallowing it easily, so how could swallowing happen? Like His words «لم يكد يراها», i.e. he did not come near to seeing it, so how could he see it?
2- Trope (al-majāz): in the words of the Exalted وَيَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ, i.e. its causes, the hardships and kinds of torment; so the speech is figurative, or by supplying an implied muḍāf.
3- Metonymy (al-kināya): in the words of the Exalted عَذابٌ غَلِيظٌ, the torment is described as thick, as a metonymy for its strength and continuity, because thickness entails strength and calls for its being continuous, all times joining in it so that there is no separation between them.
4- Exaggeration (al-ghuluww): by mentioning «كاد»; this holds consistently in all speech in which a particle of approximation is used.
5- Completion (al-tatmīm): it is of three kinds: completion of a deficiency, completion of precaution, and completion of hyperbole. He said يتجرّعه; had He said جرعه, it would not have conveyed the meaning He intended, because "gulping water" does not point to the meaning of aversion. But when He brought the tāʾ in the تفعّل form, He made it understood that he forces himself to drink it with effort, and that he suffers, as a result of drinking it, loathing and aversion beyond description. Then He took precaution in the matter, because it might be imagined that he forced himself to drink it and then the matter became easy for him afterwards, so He brought in the "almost" (al-kaydūda), i.e. he forces himself to drink it while he can hardly drink it. Had He been content with al-kaydūda, the meaning would have been sound but without hyperbole; but when يسيغه came, it made it understood that he does not swallow it easily but chokes on it, so that he drinks it only after great hardship, gulp after gulp, and so his torment is prolonged, now by heat and now by thirst.

* Benefits:
- The conjunction «أو» has several meanings, which we summarise as follows:
doubt, vagueness, permission, choice, combining two things like the wāw, digression (iḍrāb) like «بل», division, being in the sense of «إلا» and in the sense of «إلى»; it also comes for approximation, condition, and partition.
In all, twelve meanings, whose explanation you will find in the large works, as well as the examples for them..!

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (الّذين) a relative, muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of genitive. (كفروا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent). (بربّهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفروا), and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being "in what is recited to you", and its place is before the mubtadaʾ. (أعمالهم) mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) for the mubtadaʾ (مثل)… with the prepositional phrase (كرماد) as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.] ... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi. (كرماد) a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أعمالهم. (اشتدّت) a past verb ... and (التاء) is for the feminine. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اشتدّت), by its being made to carry the meaning of طارت ("flew"). (الريح) fāʿil, nominative. (في يوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اشتدّت). عاصف a naʿt (adjective) of يوم, genitive (majrūr). (لا) negative. (يقدرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (من) a preposition. (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيء. (كسبوا) like كفروا. (على شيء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يقدرون). (ذلك) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ ... and (اللام) is for distance, and (الكاف) for address; the reference is to the parable about their deeds. (هو) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). (الضلال) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك, nominative. (البعيد) a naʿt of الضلال, nominative.
The clause «مثل الّذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «أعمالهم كرماد ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «اشتدّت به الريح ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of رماد.
The clause «لا يقدرون ...» has no grammatical position: another explanatory resumption.
The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «ذلك.. الضلال ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(رماد): a primitive (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in His words مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ أَعْمالُهُمْ كَرَمادٍ اشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيحُ.
The upshot of the parable: their deeds — in their coming to nothing and going away as scattered dust, since they were sought without any foundation of knowledge of Allah the Exalted, faith in Him, and being for His sake — are likened to ashes that the storm wind has blown away and scattered. The thing likened is compound: those who disbelieved and their deeds; the thing it is likened to is the ashes; and the point of resemblance is that the storm wind blows the ashes away and scatters their parts, just as disbelief nullifies deeds.
2- Rational (cognitive) trope (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī): in attributing the storming to the day in the words of the Exalted «في يوم عاصف». العصف is the intensifying of the wind; the time in which it blows is described by it by figurative attribution, like "his day is fasting and his night is standing in prayer", for hyperbole.

safi-cedvel:19-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation. (لم) a particle of negation and jussive. (تر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you". (أنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (خلق) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "He". (السّموات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (الأرض) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات by the wāw, accusative. (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of خلق or of its object. (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (يشأ) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (يذهبكم) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) ... and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil of both verbs is a pronoun, its implied form being "He". (يأت) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the verb يذهبكم, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "He". (بخلق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأت). (جديد) a naʿt (adjective) of خلق, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «لم تر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلق ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أنّ الله خلق ...) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of تر. The clause «يشأ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يذهبكم ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يأت ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يذهبكم.
(الواو) a conjunction. (ما) negative, operating like ليس. (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as the noun of ما ... and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (على الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عزيز. (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (عزيز) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما.
The clause «ما ذلك.. بعزيز» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إن يشأ ...

* Benefits:
- وما ذلك على الله بعزيز:
The bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and it is preceded by a negation.
We have previously spoken about the kinds of bāʾ, among them the redundant one, which conveys emphasis. The grammatical position of (عزيز) differs according to how we regard «ما»: if it is Ḥijāzī, then «عزيز» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «ما»; and if it is Tamīmī, then it is in the position of nominative as a khabar, and «ما» is inoperative, having no effect. His words «من محيص» are of the same pattern as «بعزيز».

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (برزوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent). (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (برزوا); it involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the recompense of Allah" — or "the reckoning of Allah" —. (جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), [Translator's note: so in the source, «حال منصوبة فاعل برزوا»; presumably "from the fāʿil of"] the fāʿil of برزوا. (الفاء) a conjunction. (قال) a past verb. (الضعفاء) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (اللام) a preposition. (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (قال). (استكبروا) like برزوا. (إنّا) a particle of emphasis and accusative ... and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (كنّا) an incomplete past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn… and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of كان. (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl of (تبعا) — an adjective placed before the noun it qualifies —. (تبعا) the khabar (predicate) of كنّا, accusative. (الفاء) linking the answer of an implied condition. (هل) an interrogative particle, for rebuke. (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (مغنون) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (عن) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (مغنون). (من عذاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl of شيء. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition [Note: Or it is a genuine preposition of partition, so that it, with its genitive noun, is attached to (مغنون).], (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) governed by مغنون. (قالوا) like برزوا. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (هدانا) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (اللام) occurring in the answer of لو. (هديناكم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn ... and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (سواء) a fronted khabar, nominative. (علينا) like عنّا, attached to سواء. (الهمزة) a maṣdar-forming particle of equalisation (taswiya). (جزعنا) like هدينا. (أم) a conjunction. (صبرنا) like هدينا. (ما) negative, inoperative. (لنا) like لكم, attached to a fronted khabar. (من محيص) like من شيء, and the noun is nominative in position as mubtadaʾ.
The clause «برزوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قال الضعفاء ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «استكبروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «إنّا كنّا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «كنّا.. تبعا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «هل أنتم مغنون ...» is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the answer of an implied condition, i.e.: "if the torment comes to us, then will you ..."
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لو هدانا الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «هديناكم ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition (لو).
The clause «سواء علينا أجزعنا ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أجزعنا ...) is in the position of nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «جزعنا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (الهمزة).
The clause «صبرنا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause جزعنا.
The clause «ما لنا من محيص ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.

* Morphology:
(تبعا): either it is the plural of تابع, like خدم and خادم… in which case [the singular] is the active participle of the triliteral تبع, its pattern being فاعل… or it is an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb تبع used in the sense of the active participle; the pattern of تبع is فعل with two fatḥas.
(مغنون): the plural of المغني, the active participle of the quadriliteral (أغنى); its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn… In (مغنون) there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the yāʾ was dropped after being made quiescent and its vowel transferred to the nūn, because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the pattern of مغنون is مفعون — with ḍamma on the mīm and the ʿayn —.

safi-cedvel:22-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (قال الشيطان) like قال الضعفاء [Note: In the previous verse (21).], (لمّا) an adverb containing the meaning of condition, in the sense of "when" (ḥīna), indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the answer. (قضي) a past verb, passive. (الأمر) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative. (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb). (وعدكم) a past verb, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is "He". (وعد) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الحقّ) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) a conjunction. (وعدتكم) a verb, fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi. (الفاء) a conjunction. (أخلفتكم) like وعدتكم, and the second object is omitted, i.e. "I broke the promise to you". (الواو) a conjunction. (ما) a particle of negation. (كان) an incomplete past verb. (اللام) a preposition and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان. (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of سلطان. (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (سلطان) genitive in form, nominative in position, the noun of كان. (إلّا) a particle of exception. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle. (دعوتكم) like وعدتكم. (الفاء) a conjunction. (استجبتم) a past verb with its fāʿil. (لي) like the first, attached to (استجبتم).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن دعوتكم..) is in the position of accusative by disconnected exception (al-istithnāʾ al-munqaṭiʿ).
(الفاء) linking the answer of an implied condition. (لا) the jussive lā of prohibition. (تلوموني) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection (al-wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) a conjunction. (لوموا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the (النون)… and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (أنفسكم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative… and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi. (ما) negative, operating like ليس. (أنا) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as the noun of ما. (الباء) a redundant preposition. (مصرخكم) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما…
and (كم) like the last. (الواو) a conjunction. (ما أنتم بمصرخيّ) like ما أنا بصرخكم [Translator's note: so in the source, for بمصرخكم], the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped because of the annexation, and the second (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi. (إنّ) like the first, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (كفرت) like استجبتم. (الباء) a preposition. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. (أشركتم) like استجبتم, and (الواو) is redundant, a lengthening (ishbāʿ) of the vowel of the mīm, and (النون) is for protection, and (الياء), dropped for lightness, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (من) a preposition. (قبل) a noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (أشركتم) [Note: Or attached to (كفرت).], (إنّ الظالمين) like إنّ الله, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ. (لهم) like لي, attached to a fronted khabar. (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (أليم) a naʿt (adjective) of عذاب, nominative.
The clause «قال الشيطان ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قضي الأمر ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e.: "Satan said"… and the condition — its protasis and its answer — has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «إنّ الله وعدكم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «وعدكم ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «وعدتكم ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause إنّ الله.
The clause «أخلفتكم ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause وعدكم.
The clause «ما كان لي.. سلطان» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause [Translator's note: the source reads «قول القول»].
The clause «دعوتكم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «استجبتم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause دعوتكم.
The clause «لا تلوموني ...» is in the position of jussive as the answer of an implied condition, i.e. "if you want the truth, then do not blame me ..."
The clause «لوموا ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause لا تلوموني..
The clause «ما أنا بمصرخكم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «ما أنتم بمصرخيّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «إنّي كفرت ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The clause «كفرت ...» is in the position of [Translator's note: the case word is missing in the source] the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «أشركتموني ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أشركتموني ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (كفرت).
The clause «إنّ الظّالمين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: This clause may be the speech of Allah the Exalted — which is the apparent meaning — or the completion of Satan's speech above.].
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(مصرخ): the active participle of the quadriliteral أصرخ, meaning "to succour"; its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the words of the Exalted إِنِّي كَفَرْتُ بِما أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ, the "associating" is a metaphor, likening obedience to it and putting it in its place; or because, when they associated idols and the like [with Allah] through his leading them into that, it was as though they had associated him. And the "disbelief" is a trope for disavowal, as in the words of the Exalted وَيَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ. What is meant is: if your associating me with Allah the Exalted is what made you hope for my support for you, and made you imagine that you have a right over me, then I have disowned that and did not approve of it, so no tie remains between me and you. The thing likened has been omitted and the thing it is likened to retained, by way of dependent explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tabaʿiyya).

* Benefits:
1- Dialogue is one of the established Quranic styles. Although dialogue is one of the elements of narrative, in many places of the Noble Quran it comes to establish a truth or present a picture; so it and the parable are twins. We see in these verses a vivid picture portraying the oppressed, the arrogant, and the third of them, Satan, standing and conversing before Allah, each casting blame on the other — but that availed them nothing before Allah..!

safi-cedvel:23-23.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (أدخل) a past verb, passive. (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (آمنوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent). (عملوا) like آمنوا. (الصّالحات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (جنّات) mafʿūl bihi governed by أدخل, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (تجري) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ. (من تحتها) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تجري) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الأنهار.], and it involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "beneath its trees" or "its dwellings", and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الأنهار) fāʿil, nominative. (خالدين) a ḥāl of the relative. (في) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to خالدين. (بإذن) a preposition and its genitive noun, a second ḥāl of the relative [Note: Or a ḥāl of the pronoun concealed in خالدين.], (ربّهم) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr)… and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (تحيّتهم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative… and (هم) like the last. (فيها) like the first, attached to (تحيتهم). (سلام) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative, and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being عليكم ("upon you")…
and the nominal clause is the khabar of التحيّة.
The clause «أدخل الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا.
The clause «تجري ... الأنهار» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of جنّات.
The clause «تحيّتهم ... سلام» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the relative.
The clause «سلام (عليكم) ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ تحيّتهم.

safi-cedvel:24-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation. (لم) a particle of negation and jussive. (تر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you". (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). (ضرب) a past verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (مثلا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (كلمة) badal (substitute) for the object, accusative [Note: Some — such as al-Zamakhsharī — make (ضرب) take two objects… (كلمة) being the first object and (مثلا) the second object.], (طيّبة) a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة, accusative. (كشجرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of كلمة [Note: The preposition may be attached to an omitted khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is like a tree".], (أصلها) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative… and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi. (ثابت) khabar (predicate), nominative. (الواو) a conjunction. (فرعها في السماء) like أصلها ثابت, the khabar coming as a quasi-clause — a preposition and its genitive noun —.
The clause «لم تر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ضرب الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of seeing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
The clause «أصلها ثابت ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of شجرة [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of شجرة, because it has been qualified.].
The clause «فرعها في السماء ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause أصلها ثابت.
(تؤتي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is "it", i.e. the tree. (أكلها) mafʿūl bihi, accusative… and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi. (كلّ) a noun standing in for the adverb, accusative, attached to (تؤتي). (حين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (بإذن ربّها) like بإذن ربّهم [Note: In verse (23) of this sura.], and the preposition and its genitive noun are a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تؤتي. (الواو) resumptive. (يضرب) an imperfect verb, nominative. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الأمثال) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضرب), by its being made to carry the meaning of يبيّن ("make clear"). (لعلّهم) a particle of hope (tarajjī) and accusative… and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of لعلّ. (يتذكّرون) an imperfect verb, nominative… and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «تؤتي ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of شجرة [Note: Or in the position of genitive as a naʿt of شجرة.].
The clause «يضرب الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لعلّهم يتذكّرون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يتذكّرون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(ثابت): the active participle of the triliteral ثبت; its pattern is فاعل.
(فرعها): a noun that is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), its pattern being فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; it then passed into the meaning of the active participle, in the sense of what branches off from the root.

* Rhetoric:
- Representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the words of the Exalted ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُها ثابِتٌ وَفَرْعُها فِي السَّماءِ. In this simile the Exalted mentioned a tree described by four qualities, then likened the good word to it: the first quality is its being (طيبة) "good", the second its (أصلها ثابت) "root being firm", the third its (فرعها في السماء) "branches being in the sky", and the fourth its being (دائمة الثمر) "ever-fruitful". The point of resemblance in representing faith by the tree is that a tree is a tree only through three things: a deep-set root, an upright trunk, and a lofty branch; likewise faith is complete only through three things: assent with the heart, utterance with the tongue, and action with the limbs. The three qualities exist on the side of the thing it is likened to as sensory, while on the side of the thing likened they are abstract.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (كلمة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (خبيثة) a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة, genitive. (كشجرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "like the likeness of a tree". (خبيثة) a naʿt of شجرة, genitive. (اجتثّت) a past verb, passive… and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it". (من فوق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اجتثّت). (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (ما لها من قرار) like ما لها من محيص [Note: In verse (21) of this sura.].
The clause «مثل كلمة ... كشجرة» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اجتثّت ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of شجرة.
The clause «ما لها من قرار» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of genitive as a second naʿt of شجرة… or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (اجتثّت).].

* Morphology:
(قرار): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the triliteral verb قرّ; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ. The verb has other maṣdars: قرور with ḍamma on the qāf, قرّ with fatḥa on the qāf, تقرار, and تقرة with fatḥa on the tāʾ and kasra on the qāf.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): also in likening the evil word to the evil tree that is not firm, as though it had been uprooted or as though it were cast on the face of the earth, so that it does not sink into the ground — rather its roots are on the face of the ground — and it has no branches extending upward to the sky. This is the meaning of His words ما لَها مِنْ قَرارٍ.
Rhetoric 2- Rational (cognitive) trope (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī) in His words تُؤْتِي أُكُلَها: the verb of giving is attributed to other than its real agent, because the palm tree does not [itself] give its fruit.

* Benefits:
- In praise of the word:
However much thinkers have exalted the station of the word and sought for it freedom and sanctity, they have not reached, in valuing it, the esteem and sanctity Allah intended for it, and the clarification of its great importance in societies.
The good word is like the good tree: its roots are struck deep in the earth and its branches float in the sky. As for the evil word, its case is that of the evil tree that has been uprooted from the surface of the earth, having no settledness or stability.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(يثّبت) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (آمنوا) a past verb with its fāʿil. (بالقول) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يثّبت). (الثابت) a naʿt (adjective) of القول, genitive (majrūr). (في الحياة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يثّبت). (الدنيا) a naʿt of الحياة, genitive, the sign of the genitive being an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif. (الواو) a conjunction. (في الآخرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what the first genitive noun is attached to, so it is conjoined to it. (الواو) a conjunction. (يضلّ الله الظالمين) like يثّبت الله الذين… and the sign of the accusative of the object is the yāʾ. (الواو) a conjunction. (يفعل الله ما يشاء) like يثبّت الله الذين آمنوا, and the fāʿil of يشاء is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He".
The clause «يثبّت الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذّين).
The clause «يضلّ الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يفعل الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).

safi-cedvel:28-30.t:
* I'rab:
(لم تر) its i'rab has been given [Note: In verse (24) of this sura.], (إلى) a preposition. (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تر), by its being made to carry the meaning of تنظر ("look"). (بدّلوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent). (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (كفرا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) a conjunction. (أحلّوا قومهم دار) like بدّلوا نعمة الله كفرا ... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (البوار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «لم تر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «بدّلوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الّذين).
The clause «أحلّوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
(جهنّم) badal (substitute) for (دار البوار) [Note: Or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) ... or the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned after it, the clause after it being explicative.], accusative. (يصلونها) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)…
and (الواو) is the fāʿil, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstance). (بئس) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame. (القرار) fāʿil, nominative, and the specific object of blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being هي ("it").
The clause «يصلونها ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of جهنّم.
The clause «بئس القرار ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun [Note: It may be resumptive, and so have no grammatical position.].
(الواو) a conjunction. (جعلوا) like بدّلوا. (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a second object. (أندادا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (اللام) the lām of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba). (يضلّوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn… and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (عن سبيله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يضلّوا), by its being made to carry the meaning of يبعدوا ("lead away"), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (قل) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". (تمتّعوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn…
and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الفاء) causal. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) —. (مصيركم) the noun of إنّ, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إلى النار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يضلّوا..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (جعلوا).
The clause «جعلوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause بدّلوا..
The clause «يضلّوا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تمتّعوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «إنّ مصيركم إلى النار ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya) [Note: Or it is a causal explanation of something implied, i.e.: "Enjoyment will not benefit you, because your destination is the Fire."].

* Morphology:
(البوار): the maṣdar of بار يبور; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ. There is another maṣdar, بور with ḍamma on the bāʾ, meaning destruction. البوار originally means stagnation (of trade), then it was borrowed for destruction, because when something stagnates it becomes of no use, so it resembles destruction in this respect.

* Rhetoric:
1- Wonderment expressed in the form of a question: in the words of the Exalted أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ كُفْراً there is a causing of wonder, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or for everyone, at the falsehoods the disbelievers produced, which could hardly issue from anyone with the least perception; i.e. have you not looked at those who exchanged the blessing of Allah — i.e. thanks for His blessing, exalted be He — by putting in its place a great «disbelief» and ingratitude for it?
1- Dependent explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tabaʿiyya): in the words of the Exalted لِيُضِلُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ.. Since leading astray, or going astray, was the result of the "making" mentioned, it was likened to the purpose and the motivating cause, so its particle was used for it by way of dependent metaphor.

safi-cedvel:49-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ترى) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its nominative marking being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; the fāʿil (agent) is "you". (المجرمين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), its accusative marking being the yāʾ. (يومئذ) an adverbial (ẓarf), accusative [[or indeclinable (mabnī), compounded with إذ like the indeclinable adverbial compounds.]], attached (mutaʿalliq) to (ترى). إذ is an adverb indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a genitive muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is a substitute for an omitted clause. (مقرّنين) ḥāl (circumstantial) from المجرمين, accusative, its accusative marking being the yāʾ. (في الأصفاد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مقرّنين [[or attached to a second ḥāl from المجرمين.]].
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive [[or conjoined to the clause برزوا, in the state of the ḥāl.]].
(سرابيلهم) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (هم) is a pronoun in genitive construct (muḍāf ilayhi). (من قطران) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (الواو) conjunction. (تغشى) like ترى. (وجوههم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هم) is like the first. (النار) fāʿil of تغشى, nominative.
The clause «سرابيلهم من قطران ...» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl from المجرمين [[or resumptive.]].
The clause «تغشى ... النار» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
(اللام) for purpose. (يجزي) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (كلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (نفس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (ما) a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted. (كسبت) a past verb; (التاء) is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "she".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجزي) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did that".
(إنّ الله سريع) like إنّ الله عزيز [[in verse (27) of this sura.]]; (الحساب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «يجزي الله ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle (أن) that is implied.
The clause «كسبت ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ الله سريع ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(مقرّنين): plural of مقرَّن, a passive participle of the quadriliteral قرّن; its wazn is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and a doubled fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(الأصفاد): plural of صفد, a noun for fetter and shackle (الغلّ, with ḍamma on the ghayn); its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas, and the wazn of the plural is أفعال.
(سرابيل): plural of سربال, a noun for garment; its wazn is فعلال, with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(قطران): a noun for the substance with which camels are smeared against mange; its wazn is فعلان, with fatḥa then kasra (and the ṭāʾ is sometimes given sukūn) [[and it is said that it is made up of two words: قطر, meaning copper, and آن, an active participle of أنى يأنى, meaning "it reached extreme heat".]].

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(ها) a particle of alerting. (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (بلاغ) khabar, nominative. (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بلاغ [[or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بلاغ.]]. (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) for purpose. (ينذروا) a passive imperfect verb, accusative, its accusative marking being the dropping of the nūn; and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (ينذروا); the bāʾ is causal.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينذروا) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He sent that down" [[or attached to بلاغ if the prepositional phrase (للناس) is an adjective.]], conjoined to an implied element, that is: "He sent that down so that they may be advised and so that they may be warned ..."
(الواو) conjunction. (ليعلموا) like لينذروا, except in the active voice. (أنّما) kāffa and makfūfa (the restraining particle and the restrained). (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ. (إله) khabar, nominative. (واحد) naʿt of إله, nominative. (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) for purpose. (يذّكّر) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (أولو) fāʿil, nominative, its nominative marking being the wāw, for it is attached to the sound masculine plural. (الألباب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «هذا بلاغ ...» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ينذروا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle (أن).
The clause «يعلموا ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second particle (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلموا) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to what the interpreted maṣdar (لينذروا) is attached to, because it is conjoined to it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّما هو إله واحد) is in the position of an accusative, standing in for the two objects of يعلموا; and the kāffa (ما) is of no consequence, since (أنّ) remains a maṣdar particle.
The clause «يذّكّر أولو الألباب ...» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the third particle (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يذّكّر) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to what the interpreted maṣdar (لينذروا) is attached to, because it is conjoined to it.

safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
